name: What type of paint finish works best for garage walls and trim?

mainEntity.name: What type of paint finish works best for garage walls and trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most homeowners want a garage that is easier to clean and better protected from moisture and scuffs. For garage walls and trim, durable latex acrylic paint with a satin or eggshell finish is commonly recommended because it cleans well and handles garage conditions better than flat paint.
acceptedAnswer.description: A durable latex acrylic paint with a satin or eggshell finish is usually the safest choice. It is easier to clean and better suited to garage wear and moisture.
